Finding and Diagnosing Cancer in Children

Because cancer in childhood is rare, there are no recommended screening tests for children who have average risk. If a child has a family history of cancer or if they are diagnosed with a type of cancer linked to a family cancer syndrome, the healthcare team might suggest talking to a genetic counselor.
